title: SCHEMA_chart_v2 — Classical natal chart JSON (AmanJyoshi / traditionalchart)
description: Contract between the calculator (astro_calendar/natal_classical.py, branch classical) and the reading prompts (30_prompts/PROMPT_*_en_v*.md). The calculator WRITES this file; a prompt READS it and interprets only. The AI must never recompute positions, dignities, scores, houses or aspects — every needed value is present here. Conventions: tropical zodiac; seven classical planets; Regiomontanus houses with Lilly's 5° cusp rule; Dorothean triplicities (+3 to the sect ruler only); Egyptian terms (operative) with Ptolemaic/Lilly terms as audit only; Chaldean faces; mean node; chart sect by the ASC–DSC horizon; peregrine −5, cancelled by sign/exaltation/mixed mutual reception, never added on top of detriment/fall; almuten ties at a single degree resolved by house position, almuten figuris ties reported as joint almutens. Rule source: 20_method/METHOD_本質的品位表_v1.md (v1.2, 2026-09-17). Verification status: structure and dignity tables [確定・照合済み]; accidental-dignity codes, orbs, planetary-hour details [未照合 against CA Book I]; Ptolemaic term table [未照合]; house-cusp almutens [未実装・任意]. v2 (additive superset of v1 rev.2): every v1 key keeps its place, type and meaning; new blocks (derived, houses_summary, fixed_star_contacts, boundary_warnings, vocation, timing, summary, reading_notes, provenance) carry pre-computed judgement material so that the reading prompt never recomputes anything. Items that cannot exist when the birth time is unknown (time_known: false) are nullable. Solar conditions (cazimi / combust / under beams) additionally require the planet to be in the same sign as the Sun (decision C, 2026-09-18).
x-sample: astro_calendar/schema/sample_chart_v1.json is the v1 sample; a v2 sample is produced in Phase 3
x-method: METHOD_本質的品位表_v1.md v1.2 (+ decision C pending v1.3) / METHOD_natal_v1.md v1.3 / 古典職業鑑定マニュアル v11 + 再基底化差分 2026-09-18

method.description: Chart sect by the ASC–DSC horizon: Sun in houses 7–12 → diurnal (METHOD §9).

sun_altitude.description: True altitude of the Sun in degrees (auxiliary).

borderline.description: true when the horizon method and the altitude method disagree (polar latitudes, Sun near the horizon). Mention this to the user when true.

light.description: Sect light: Sun by day, Moon by night.

rank.description: Position in the ordered Dorothean triple (1, 2 or 3).

role.description: Role of this ruler for the element. The legacy key order (昼/夜/関与) is kept for compatibility.

triplicity_lords.description: The three Dorothean triplicity lords of the sect light's sign, in order day / night / participating, with their condition. Used for the 'lords of the sect light' technique (thirds of life).

moon_phase_quarter.description: Quarter of the lunation from the Moon-minus-Sun elongation e (0<=e<360): 0-90 new_to_first, 90-180 first_to_full, 180-270 full_to_last, 270-360 last_to_new.

season_quarter.description: Quarter of the year from the Sun's sign_index: 0-2 spring, 3-5 summer, 6-8 autumn, 9-11 winter. Tropical northern-hemisphere convention; not mirrored in the southern hemisphere.

season_quarter_note.description: One-line note that season_quarter follows the quarters of the ecliptic and is not mirrored south of the equator.

sect.description: Null when the birth time is unknown (the ASC-DSC horizon is undefined).

hour_index.description: Planetary hour number counted from sunrise (1–12 day hours, 13–24 night hours).

oneOf.description: Planetary day and hour (Chaldean order from sunrise). [未照合] sunrise/sunset definition (apparent vs true) not yet documented.

planetary_day_hour.description: Planetary day/hour object, or null when sunrise/sunset cannot be computed (polar day or night). When null, skip the planetary-hour step and say why. Also null when the birth time is unknown. Sunrise and sunset are apparent (refraction at 1013.25 hPa and 0°C), taken at the centre of the Sun's disc, at sea level; see tables_used.sources.planetary_hours.

longitude.description: Ecliptic longitude in decimal degrees (tropical zodiac, 0 = 0° Aries).

position.description: Human-readable position, e.g. "Sco 28°22'". Use this string verbatim when quoting a position; never recompute it.

almuten.description: Almuten of this degree. null only when almuten_tie is true.

almuten_tie.description: true = tie not resolvable by house position (Decision ④); the human judges among almuten_candidates.

almuten_candidates.description: Planets sharing the highest essential score at this degree (before tie-break).

almuten_tie_break.description: "house_angularity" when a tie was resolved by house position (angular > succedent > cadent, Regiomontanus, 5° cusp rule). null when no tie occurred.

almuten_scores.description: Essential-dignity points each planet holds at this degree (+5/+4/+3/+2/+1; triplicity = sect ruler only; terms = Egyptian).

also_known_as.description: Other names for this point, for prompts that use another vocabulary.

minutes_to_previous_sign.description: Minutes of birth time back to the previous sign; null beyond 30.

minutes_to_next_sign.description: Minutes of birth time forward to the next sign; null beyond 30.

oneOf.description: Effective house (Regiomontanus). A planet within 5° before the next cusp is counted in the next house (Lilly). USE THIS FIELD for interpretation.

house.description: Effective house (Regiomontanus). A planet within 5° before the next cusp is counted in the next house (Lilly). USE THIS FIELD for interpretation. Null when the birth time is unknown.

oneOf.description: House by cusp only, without the 5° rule. Reference only.

house_raw.description: House by cusp only, without the 5° rule. Reference only. Null when the birth time is unknown.

oneOf.description: true when the 5° rule moved the planet into the next house (house ≠ house_raw).

near_next_cusp.description: true when the 5° rule moved the planet into the next house (house ≠ house_raw). Null when the birth time is unknown.

oneOf.description: true when in houses 7–12 (above the ASC–DSC horizon).

above_horizon.description: true when in houses 7–12 (above the ASC–DSC horizon). Null when the birth time is unknown.

dignities.description: Essential dignities the planet holds at its own position. "triplicity" appears only for the sect triplicity ruler.

debilities.description: Debilities that are actually scored. "peregrine" appears here only when it contributes −5; when the planet is in detriment/fall, peregrine is NOT listed here (Decision ③: no double counting).

oneOf.description: true if the planet has no essential dignity and no sign/exaltation mutual reception (Lilly + Lehman). May be true while not scored — see debilities and score_note.

peregrine.description: true if the planet has no essential dignity and no sign/exaltation mutual reception (Lilly + Lehman). May be true while not scored — see debilities and score_note. Null when the birth time is unknown and the sect decides it (peregrine_uncertain).

peregrine_cancelled_by.description: Set when a mutual reception by sign, exaltation or mixed (sign×exaltation) cancels peregrine status (Decision ②, METHOD §8.2 v1.2).

mutual_receptions.description: Mutual receptions by sign / exaltation / mixed with other planets. Aspect is not required.

score.description: Essential dignity total: +5 domicile, +4 exaltation, +3 triplicity (sect ruler only), +2 term (Egyptian), +1 face; −5 detriment, −4 fall, −5 peregrine (not added on top of detriment/fall). METHOD §8.

score_note.description: Explanation when the score deviates from a naive sum (e.g. peregrine present but not scored because of detriment/fall).

triplicity.description: Null when the sect is unknown (the triplicity ruler that would score).

rulers_of_position.description: Which planet rules the degree the planet occupies, by each dignity. triplicity = the sect ruler of the sign's triplicity. term = Egyptian terms (operative table).

sect_ruler.description: Null when the sect is unknown, in which case triplicity is not scored.

triplicity_rulers.description: Dorothean three triplicity rulers of the sign occupied. Only sect_ruler receives +3; day/night/participating are for reception, radicality and other qualitative judgments (METHOD §3).

differs.description: true if the Ptolemaic (Lilly) term ruler differs from the Egyptian term ruler.

has_term.description: Whether the planet would be in its own term under the Ptolemaic table.

term_audit.description: AUDIT ONLY. Ptolemaic/Lilly term ruler for comparison with astro.com-style outputs. Never used for scoring, almutens or receptions. Table not yet verified against Christian Astrology Book I (verified:false in tables_used.sources.terms_audit).

peregrine_scored.description: True when "peregrine" is present in debilities, i.e. the -5 was actually counted. False when decision 3 suppressed it because the planet is in detriment or fall.

peregrine_uncertain.description: Only with time_known: false. True when the planet is a day or night triplicity ruler of its sign and has no other dignity, so that peregrine cannot be decided without the sect.

essential_dignity.description: Essential dignity of the planet at its own position (METHOD_本質的品位表_v1.md v1.2).

score.description: Sum of accidental points (Lilly's table of accidental dignities/debilities, CA Book I).

label_en.description: English label of the accidental dignity item; label_ja is kept.

items.description: Itemised accidental points. code examples: house_1 … house_12, direct, retrograde, swift, slow, oriental, occidental, increasing_light, decreasing_light, cazimi, combust, under_beams, free_of_beams, partile_conjunction_north_node, partile_conjunction_south_node, besieged_saturn_mars, conjunct_regulus, conjunct_spica, conjunct_algol. [未照合] the full code list and point values are Lilly's table as implemented in natal_classical.py; not yet machine-verified against CA Book I.

solar_phase.description: Relation to the Sun (Lilly): cazimi ≤ 0°17', combust ≤ 8°30', under the Sun's beams ≤ 17°, else free. "sun" for the Sun itself.

distance_from_sun.description: Angular distance from the Sun in degrees.

orientality.description: Oriental/occidental of the Sun (Lilly). null for the Sun.

motion.description: Motion class relative to mean daily motion. null when not applicable (Sun/Moon per implementation).

oneOf.description: Accidental dignity (Lilly). Interpretation-only; values come from the calculator. Solar conditions follow decision C (2026-09-18): cazimi (<=17'), combust (<=8°30') and under_beams (<=17°) all additionally require the planet to be in the same sign as the Sun; in a different sign the planet is free however close it is. Source: CA I ll.9344-9353 for combustion; the extension to cazimi and under beams is a project decision.

accidental_dignity.description: Accidental dignity (Lilly). Interpretation-only; values come from the calculator. Solar conditions follow decision C (2026-09-18): cazimi (<=17'), combust (<=8°30') and under_beams (<=17°) all additionally require the planet to be in the same sign as the Sun; in a different sign the planet is free however close it is. Source: CA I ll.9344-9353 for combustion; the extension to cazimi and under beams is a project decision. Null when the birth time is unknown (house points are required).

hayz.description: hayz = in sect, on the matching side of the horizon, and in a sign of matching gender; half_hayz = partially; contrary = opposite. Empty string when not evaluated.

max_orb.description: Allowed orb = half the sum of the two bodies' moieties (Lilly).

partile.description: Same degree number in both signs.

condition.description: Whether the faster body is applying to or separating from the exact aspect.

direction.description: Sinister = cast forward in zodiacal order; dexter = cast backward.

reception_from_to.description: Dignities by which `from` receives `to` (i.e. `from` rules the degree `to` occupies). Triplicity reception counts all three Dorothean rulers.

reception_softens.description: For squares and oppositions: true when there is mutual reception or one-way reception by domicile or exaltation. Project convention.

reception_minor.description: True when the only reception is by term or face, which does not count as softening. Project convention.

time_unknown_caveat.description: True when the birth time is unknown: applying/separating was judged from the speeds at local noon.

items.description: Aspect by Lilly's moieties, with reception. Aspects to ASC/MC included. Whole-sign aspects (sign-to-sign) are NOT listed; derive them from signs if a technique needs them.

almutens.description: Planet(s) with the highest total. More than one = joint almutens; read BOTH as rulers of the geniture (Decision ⑤, METHOD §10 v1.2). Ties are NOT broken by house position here.

almuten.description: Single almuten, or null when almutens has more than one entry.

ranking.description: All seven planets by total, descending (ties keep table order; do not read the order within a tie as a ranking).

accidental.description: Reference only; not used for ranking.

longitude.description: Ecliptic longitude in decimal degrees (tropical zodiac, 0 = 0° Aries).

position.description: Human-readable position, e.g. "Sco 28°22'". Use this string verbatim when quoting a position; never recompute it.

fixed_stars.description: Regulus, Spica, Algol (others may be added). Conjunction flags appear in accidental_dignity.items. Fixed stars are a correction layer, not a primary factor.

longitude.description: Ecliptic longitude in decimal degrees (tropical zodiac, 0 = 0° Aries).

position.description: Human-readable position, e.g. "Sco 28°22'". Use this string verbatim when quoting a position; never recompute it.

house.description: Null when the birth time is unknown.

modern_reference.description: Uranus, Neptune, Pluto for reference ONLY. A classical reading prompt must not use them as rulers, in dignities, or in the almuten; at most mention them if the user asks.

moon_range.description: Only with time_known: false: the Moon's longitude at the start and end of the local day, so that its range is explicit. Null otherwise.

derived.description: Pre-computed reading material. Every value here is re-derivable from planets[], houses[], aspects[] and lots; it carries no interpretation.

ranking_basis.description: total_score in full mode; essential_score when the birth time is unknown.

dignity_ranking.description: The seven planets by descending total_score. Ties are ordered by house position (angular > succedent > cadent); planets that are still tied share a rank and are marked tie: true.

lord_of_geniture.description: primary = almuten_figuris.almutens (decision 5: joint almutens when tied); secondary = strongest_planet (decision 3).

co_significator.description: Condition of the almuten of the ascendant when it differs from the domicile lord (decision 2); null when they are the same planet.

out_of_sect_malefic.description: Mars in a diurnal chart, Saturn in a nocturnal chart.

in_sect_benefic.description: Jupiter in a diurnal chart, Venus in a nocturnal chart.

lord_in_aversion.description: True when the difference of sign_index between the lord's sign and the cusp's sign is 1, 5, 7 or 11 (decision 10).

aversions_to_ascendant.description: Planets whose sign_index differs from the ascendant's by 1, 5, 7 or 11.

reading_order.description: Decision 12: sect light, lord of the ascendant (then its almuten when different), lord of the geniture, out-of-sect malefic, then the rest in dignity_ranking order; first occurrence wins.

thresholds.description: Thresholds behind classification. Provisional operating values.

planets_by_house.description: House number (as a string key) to the planets in it.

houses_summary.description: Which signs are intercepted, which fall on two cusps, which houses are empty and which planets are in each house. Null when the birth time is unknown.

fixed_star_contacts.description: Reserved. Contacts between the catalogue stars and the bodies, angles and lots. Null in v2 rev.1: the star set (royal stars and a few others) is on hold until METHOD settles it. The three v1 stars stay in fixed_stars.

boundary_warnings.description: Places where a small error in the birth time or a threshold changes the chart. Level 1 informational, 2 material, 3 blocking.

oneOf.description: Vocational significator (SKU 3). Steps 1-5 of the procedure are executed as a rule engine; every judgement uses only the values in candidates[], which come from the shared dignity engine. No profession words are produced here.

candidates.description: Mars, Venus and Mercury in that fixed order.

essential.description: Copied verbatim from the shared dignity engine (decision B).

has_dignity.description: True when dignities[] is not empty (decision A; peregrine is not used for this).

solar.description: Solar condition under decision C: same_sign_as_sun must be true for cazimi, combust or under_beams.

dissociate.description: True when the aspect holds by degree but the signs do not agree.

moon_aspect.description: Closest Ptolemaic aspect to the Moon, or null.

eligibility_reasons.description: Why each rule failed, in words, for audit.

mc_almuten_all.description: Almuten of the MC degree over all seven planets (decision 4).

mc_almuten_three.description: Almuten of the MC degree restricted to Mars, Venus and Mercury, with the rule 2B tie-break (higher dignity, then nearer to an angle, then agreeing with the sect).

significator.description: The chosen planet and the rule that fired. planet is null when no rule settles it (see boundary_warnings).

multiple_qualified.description: Candidates that also satisfied the rule that fired. The chosen one has the highest total_score; a remaining tie is flagged. Project convention.

extension_flag.description: True when rule 2B fired, which is a project extension.

settlement_tier.description: Rules 1 and 2A give A, rule 2B gives B, rules 3-5 give C.

not_excluded.description: Candidates other than the significator that no rule excluded; the prompt must not dismiss them.

combinations.description: Aspects between the significator and other planets, mapped to the rule_key of the combination table. No profession words.

sign_attributes.description: Attributes of the significator's sign from the procedure's tables (verified: false). Attributes only, no selection.

success.description: Four conditions of success. strong_essential means essential score >= 3; grade is high for 4, mid for 2-3, low for 0-1. Project convention.

auxiliary.description: Conditions of the auxiliary places: houses 10, 2, 6 and 11, the two lots, the Moon and the Sun.

dispositors.description: Condition of the domicile lord of each candidate's sign. Provided instead of a warning, because "badly placed" is not yet defined.

fixed_stars.description: Contacts of the v1 fixed stars with the candidates and the weakest planet. The wider catalogue is on hold.

warnings.description: Only the four mechanically decidable warnings.

durability_layer.description: The three ordered triplicity lords of the MC sign, read only. Never added to any score (verified: false).

system_divergence.description: Parallel computation with the Ptolemaic term and triplicity audit tables. It never changes the judgement and must not be quoted in summary.

boundary_warnings.description: Vocation-specific boundary warnings; same form as the top-level array.

timing_slice.description: Reserved; null in v2 rev.1 (METHOD_timing not written yet).

vocation.description: Vocational block (SKU 3). Null when the birth time is unknown or when the procedure is not run; vocation_blocked_reason then says why.

vocation_blocked_reason.description: Why vocation is null, e.g. "birth time unknown". Null when vocation is present.

oneOf.description: Time-lord block (SKU 2). Reserved: null in v2 rev.1. Only the shape is validated; the values wait for METHOD_timing.

timing.description: Time-lord block (SKU 2). Null in v2 rev.1; the keys and types are reserved so that a later revision can fill them.

summary.description: Eight fixed English lines (sect, ascendant, lord of the geniture, strongest and weakest, out-of-sect malefic, lots, flags, birth time and version). The wording is a template shared by every implementation and contains no interpretation. Lines 1, 2, 5 and 6 read "n/a (birth time unknown)" when the time is unknown.

reading_notes.description: Fixed English instructions for the reading prompt: everything is already computed, raw fields win over summary and derived, audit fields are never grounds for a judgement, boundary flags mark fragile statements, and the rule-4 moiety is unrelated to aspect orbs. A sixth note is added when the birth time is unknown.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp; the only value that changes between runs.

reference_generator.description: e.g. "natal_classical.py@e88df93" when a reference implementation was used.

x-requirements: 10_schema/SCHEMA_v2_要件書_20260918.md v0.3 (第 I 部). Additive superset of v1 rev.2.

aspect_contact.description: One aspect taken from aspects[]: who casts it, which aspect, its orb, whether it is partile, and whether reception softens it.

condition.description: Standard condition block: the state of one planet, copied from planets[] and aspects[] so that no recomputation is needed. classification uses the thresholds in derived.thresholds.

afflicted_by.description: Conjunction, square or opposition from Saturn or Mars, taken from aspects[].

assisted_by.description: Conjunction, trine or sextile from Jupiter or Venus, taken from aspects[].

classification.description: favoured = essential >= threshold and accidental >= threshold; effort = essential <= threshold and accidental <= threshold; otherwise neutral. Thresholds are provisional (METHOD_natal_v1 decision 5).

source_entry.description: Provenance label for one table or rule, as in v1 tables_used.sources.

almuten_keys.description: Almuten of a single degree (METHOD §10 decision 4): dignity points of the seven planets at that degree; ties are resolved by house position (angular > succedent > cadent) and, if still tied, almuten is null with almuten_tie true.

ranking_extreme.description: Head or tail of dignity_ranking. co[] lists the other planets on the same score when tie is true.
